text: {"reconstruction":4,"feasibility":4,"rationale":"The proposal has the right core steps in the right order (From/To autocomplete, date, Passengers/Class with counts and cabin, Confirm, Show flights, then price box plus Select fare, repeated), and splitting passengers into adults/children/infants is a reasonable refinement; however, it adds a \"One way\" step and a date \"Continue\" step that the occurrence doesn't show (the two fare selections suggest a return trip, not one-way), and it lists parameters it never uses or defines (fare_type, stopover), which makes it less exact to automate."}

data.rationale: The proposal has the right core steps in the right order (From/To autocomplete, date, Passengers/Class with counts and cabin, Confirm, Show flights, then price box plus Select fare, repeated), and splitting passengers into adults/children/infants is a reasonable refinement; however, it adds a "One way" step and a date "Continue" step that the occurrence doesn't show (the two fare selections suggest a return trip, not one-way), and it lists parameters it never uses or defines (fare_type, stopover), which makes it less exact to automate.
